item.title: Added · Shared Public Way paseo (Dr Maya Angelou Lane, north segment): The Shared Public Way paseo between The Canyon and the Visa building added on its real lot. The 2019 Phase 1 submittal planned it as part of Phase 1; the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes record staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G (Resolutions 25-05, 25-06), and the Port's June 2026 report says Phase 1 was completed in 2025 and the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure.
item.description: The Shared Public Way paseo between The Canyon and the Visa building added on its real lot. Source: 2019 Phase 1 submittal; Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (sfport.com/media/10214); Port Item 8B memo, Oct 6 2023 (Parcel A, The Canyon; Parcel G Visa); Port Item 11A memo, June 5 2026; DataSF Parcels.

(Jun 9, 2026)
